## Scope

Preserve the original MSV000092631/PXD044463 purified-proteasome digestion evidence through the common external-source and EvidenceStore interface. The adapter retains raw, filtered and final quantity layers, exact constructs, acquisition/protocol context, original source text, modifications/splice claims, forced-zero/missing states and explicit conflicts. It requires R only when decoding the original RData during package construction; portable readers do not need R.

Based on merged #772. Candidate 2.0.8 uses catalog 14 and retains prior catalog 11/12/13 readers. No original large data files are bundled in the Python distribution.

## Actual-source qualification

[Registered source report and frozen reproduction](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1503d67/experiments/2026-10-23_1018_codex_shared-digestion-source/README.md).

All 18 pinned original assets and 17 condition archives are retained. The real 250-file generation preserves all 218 prior source payloads byte-for-byte at separate inodes; all 33 baseline audits match. Its 11 new relations contain 388 acquisitions, 15 literal constructs, 5,792,969 original Skyline rows, 545,664 raw quantities, 121,556 filtered vectors, 53,413 final vectors and 280,664 final slots. These are mixed-grain records, not independent biological observations.

An independent verifier imports no Hitlist code: it rehashes all artifacts, reopens the original workbook/FASTA/CSV records, decodes all 34 original RData frames, checks source fields and typed values, and reproduces every canonical query hash. It retains 2,278 RF1 time conflicts, six contaminant-enzyme conflicts, 269 annotation-only rows, 62,860 forced zeros and 4,782 missing slots.

## Validation and remaining work

Format/lint, strict docs, 37 focused tests and the normal guarded suite (3,341 tests, 10 warnings) pass. The first full run exposed one stale catalog-version assertion; its correction and both logs are retained. Exact production source hashes match the executed source build.

This is source support, not a training-ready recipe. RF1 remains unresolved; all-substrate quantitative preprocessing arithmetic, contiguous-product admission, replicate temporal signal, grouped evaluation and a defensible MS-response likelihood remain required. Purified digestion is not APC concentration supervision. Advances #770, which remains open. Review, final-head CI and deployment remain pending.

The separate [matched kinetic qualification](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1503d67/experiments/2026-10-23_1021_codex_independent-cut-qualification/README.md) is synthetic: exact and sampled cuts conserve mass and recover known rates. It makes no biological predictive-quality claim.
